from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
from openpyxl import load_workbook
base='https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S2211124725000117-'
headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0','Referer':'https://www.cell.com/'}
def get(name):
 data=urlopen(Request(base+name,headers=headers),timeout=60).read(); open(name,'wb').write(data)
 return load_workbook(name,read_only=True,data_only=True)
with open('compact.txt','w') as out:
 wb=get('mmc4.xlsx')
 for ws in wb.worksheets:
  if ws.title=='Table Legend': continue
  out.write(f'SHEET {ws.title}\n')
  for row in ws.iter_rows(values_only=True):
   out.write('\t'.join('' if v is None else str(v) for v in row[:7])+'\n')
 wb=get('mmc5.xlsx'); ws=wb['Table S4']
 out.write('MMC5_HEADER\n'+'\t'.join(str(v) for v in next(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True)))+'\n')
 wb=get('mmc6.xlsx'); ws=wb['Table S5']
 out.write('MMC6\n')
 for i,row in enumerate(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True)):
  out.write('\t'.join('' if v is None else str(v) for v in row)+'\n')
  if i>=20: break
 wb=get('mmc10.xlsx'); ws=wb['T. aestivum']
 out.write('MMC10_HEADER\n')
 for i,row in enumerate(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True)):
  out.write('\t'.join('' if v is None else str(v)[:120] for v in row)+'\n')
  if i>=3: break
